title: SemanticCard
$comment: DRAFT — NEEDS_REVIEW. Field set is a hypothesis; no code reads it yet. See docs/DECISIONS.md D-0007, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2 Layer C and §3, AGENTS.md §7.
description: Layer C artifact. A compact machine-readable representation of one human note. It must NOT duplicate the full human note; it exists for navigation, retrieval, routing, network understanding, change planning and token efficiency. It is never an independent source of truth.

knowledgeId.description: Stable join key between the human note and this card (AGENTS.md §7). MUST remain stable across note edits while the concept is unchanged. Instability is error SEM-ID-INSTABILITY.

description.description: Compact semantic description — a pointer to meaning, not a copy of the note.

humanNoteRef.description: Path or reference to the human note this card mirrors. Required in spirit: a card without a human note has no source of truth.

sectionIndex.description: Index of the human note's sections, so a reader can jump to the right place instead of loading the whole note.

relations.description: Typed relations to other cards in the knowledge network.

type.description: Relation vocabulary. Alignment operations (AGENTS.md §6 Layer D) are a separate concern; this is the stored network edge.

provenance.description: Evidence supporting this card's important claims. A machine claim without provenance is error SEM-PROVENANCE-MISSING.

epistemicStatus.description: Overall epistemic state of the card's content. Storing an inference must never promote it to a fact (SEM-INFERENCE-AS-FACT).

learningAssets.description: Index of learning aids associated with this concept (exercises, examples, mnemonics, ...).

integrity.description: Whether this card is still consistent with its human note and evidence.
